        result = subprocess.run(args, input=stdin, text=True, capture_output=True,
                                cwd=cwd or OUT, env=env, timeout=timeout)

        stdout, stderr, code = e.stdout or b"", e.stderr or b"", "timeout"
        if isinstance(stdout, bytes): stdout = stdout.decode(errors="replace")
        if isinstance(stderr, bytes): stderr = stderr.decode(errors="replace")
    (OUT / f"{name}.stdout").write_text(stdout)

                  timeout_seconds=timeout, exit=code, stdout=f"probes/{name}.stdout",
                  stderr=f"probes/{name}.stderr")
    try:
        parsed = json.loads(stdout)
        body = parsed.get("result", parsed)
        record["summary"] = {k: body.get(k) for k in ["status", "stopReason", "complete", "phase", "diagnostics", "counters", "stdout", "stderr"]}
        trace = body.get("trace")
        if isinstance(trace, dict):
            record["summary"]["steps"] = [{k: x.get(k) for k in ["line", "event", "stdout", "stderr"]} for x in trace.get("steps", [])]
        elif isinstance(trace, list):
            record["summary"]["steps"] = [{k: x.get(k) for k in ["line", "event", "stdout", "stderr"]} for x in trace]
    except (ValueError, AttributeError):
        record["summary"] = {"stdout_bytes":len(stdout.encode()), "stderr_first_lines":stderr.splitlines()[:6]}
    records.append(record)
    (OUT / "run-index.json").write_text(json.dumps(records, indent=2))

    return record
